desc: An album of Regional Mexican "TUMBADOS" about immigration, protest, hope, struggle, self-improvement, smuggling and vice. With elements of Banda Sinaloense music, composer Guillermo Pascual blends traditional instruments with Trap and Hip-Hop beats.

tracks.desc: A song about perseverance and overcoming life's struggles. "Aferrado" means someone who strongly holds to convictions, is intense, stubborn, and obstinate. Folks who come from below, from humble roots, who take on life's lessons head on and overcome suffering, forever moving forward. Track includes a bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonia (both steel string acoustic guitars), charchetas (Mexican french horns), valve trombone and a trap beat section.

Immigration and hope for a better future are the themes here. Taking risks on an uncertain and dangerous journey, this tune is about going north in search of work with no possessions, family and good faith. Track includes a button accordion, tuba, bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonia (both steel string acoustic guitars), charchetas (Mexican french horns), valve trombone and a hip-hop beat section.

I'm the king of the nightclub on a decadent party trip to Ibiza. "Chingón" means "the best" and I'm the man on this out of control night where the champagne is flowing with my lady crew. Track includes a button accordion, tuba, bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonia (both steel string acoustic guitars), charchetas (Mexican french horns), valve trombone and a hip-hop beat section.

The "white" leaves and the greenbacks return. The goods we sell to the gringos come from farther south. A steel bird transports the fruits of the land. Themes of smuggling and contraband. Track includes a bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonia (both steel string acoustic guitars), charchetas (Mexican french horns), valve trombone and synth bass on the intro and outro.

No one smiles. A protest song about the relentless pace of life for those who struggle. A plea to stop the violence in a tumultuous and dangerous city. Nostalgic feelings for simpler times. Track includes a bajoloche (electro-acoustic bass), requinto (12 string) and armonia (both steel string acoustic guitars), charchetas (Mexican french horns), and a valve trombone.
